queries.text: Title translated from the Brazilian edition ("Dogma e Ritual de Alta Magia"), as in the other books. Waite’s English translation is "Transcendental Magic: Its Doctrine and Ritual" (1896).
Brazilian edition "O Erotismo: Fantasias e Realidades do Amor e da Sedução", as in How to Deal with Women; the Italian original is "L’erotismo" (1986). "sem data" rendered "n.d.".
Brazilian release title "Hitch: Conselheiro Amoroso"; original title "Hitch".
